stage1_9_approach_turn_kick.description: ACTIVE (timesteps=200000). 1v0 approach + turn + kick. Warm-starts from stage1_6_final_58pct.zip (action_dim=9), which already learned turn (slot 2) and kick (slot 3). Robot now spawns at its default position (away from ball) with random orientation, and the ball is placed randomly in the opponent half — the policy must learn to use `approach_ball` (slot 1, masked during the 58% run, so its weights are essentially untrained) to navigate to the ball before turning and kicking. The kicker-cone gate was removed (2026-05-20): kicks fire whenever the ball is in kickable range regardless of orientation, matching the 58% checkpoint's training regime and rcssserver's actual kick semantics. HER `future` strategy supplies goal-conditioned relabeling so the agent sees virtual successes throughout every episode, not only on real goals.

_removed_stages_note: Previous Stage 1 curriculum (stage1_015_warm, stage1_060_warm, stage1_090_mid, stage1_120_mid, stage1_180_full) and the old stage3 (num_robots=3) were dropped 2026-05-20 in favor of a single approach+turn+kick stage warm-started from stage1_6_final_58pct.zip. Git history preserves the prior curriculum if it needs to be replayed. When re-adding a multi-robot stage, ensure the load_model checkpoint matches the new env's obs/action dims to avoid the shape-mismatch crash that previously hit at stage transitions.

model_params._action_noise_note: Bumped from 0.2 → 0.3 for stage1_9 so the untrained approach_ball logit at slot 1 gets explored. The 58% checkpoint has logits near 0.8 for turn (slot 2) / kick (slot 3) and ~0 for the previously-disabled slots; with sigma=0.2 the argmax almost never flips to slot 1, and approach_ball would never be sampled. 0.3 keeps trained behaviors mostly intact (turn/kick logits ~0.8 still dominate post-noise on average) while opening a real exploration tail toward the new action.
model_params._her_strategy_note: Switched back to 'future' (2026-05-19) after locally patching SB3 2.7.1's HerReplayBuffer._sample_goals to clamp the upper bound of the randint call — fixes the 'low >= high' crash that previously forced us onto 'final'. 'final' relabels every transition with the episode's terminal ball position, which on a 75%-off-target run reinforces the off-target behavior (HER tells the policy 'you achieved your goal' even when the ball ended up missing). 'future' relabels with diverse intermediate points and is essential for the policy to learn aim precision.
